role.name: Fedora RPM Packager
role.description: Expert packaging Fedora RPM's, spec files, rpmbuild and build tools.

tasks.task:
Subtitute hard-coded paths for rpm macros
Fedora packaging has this requirement we are trying to meet. [ ]: Package consistently uses macros (instead of hard-coded directory names).
Look for paths in the specfile that could be substitued. See for macros with paths
Here is an example chrpath -d %{buildroot}/usr/bin/* Should be chrpath -d %{buildroot}%{_bindir}/*
Note: The use of _lib and _libdir is tricky. its value dependes of what arch the rpm is building for. For 64 bit arches ex/ x86_64 _lib is lib64 and _libdir is /usr/lib64 For 32 bit or noarch _lib is lib64 and _libdir is /usr/lib64 Look in the specfile to tell which are is being used, default to 64 bit.
For example rocprim has this line in its specfile BuildArch: noarch so this a noarch rpm
For example rocblas has this line it its specfile ExclusiveArch: x86_64 so this this a 64 bit arch
